name: Sora
source:
"Being normal is boring! Trust me, I’d know, I’m the most average person you’ll ever meet!”

The local delivery boy and Ren’s biggest fan. Bouncing with unstoppable optimism and positive energy, Sora is always eager to offer Ren advice. Often times more bad than good, but hey, at least he's trying.

[From [url=https://peaceful-pastel.itch.io/project-perfectly-normal]itch.io[/url]]
